{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Cream silk blouse with a relaxed collar in a straight cut reaching the hip, color #f4dcd8, fabric pure silk crepe de Chine
High-rise tailored trousers in a wide-leg silhouette falling to the ankle, color #e8e0db, fabric lightweight wool blend
Leather ankle boots with a low block heel in a pointed toe, color #c5a085, fabric polished calfskin
Gold hoop earrings with a mixed metal finish, color #ffd700, material 14k gold and brass
Delicate pearl pendant necklace on an 18-inch chain, color #fffdd0, material freshwater pearls
A statement oversized brooch in emerald green enamel set in yellow gold pinned at the shoulder, color #50c878, material gold and enamel

This outfit strikes a bold balance between reverence for the church setting and a clear desire to stand out during the family lunch. The rich cream silk blouse paired with wide-leg wool trousers offers an elevated, neat silhouette that respects the occasion while providing comfort. The emerald green brooch serves as a powerful focal point that fulfills her wish to make a statement without being overtly flashy. Completing the look with earthy leather boots and gold jewelry grounds the outfit in autumnal tones, ensuring it feels both sophisticated and uniquely hers."}
